title: Module quiz: Setting up Claude on the cloud platforms

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: A reviewer finds a single star in the resource field of a policy statement. Which practice rule does it break?

options.text: The document must carry the current version string at the top
options.says: Ruled out because that rule concerns the version: "The policy has the version `2012-10-17`", which a star in a resource does not change.

options.text: Each entry must be a model ARN in a documented region, without wildcards
options.says: The rule is "Every resource is a model ARN with a region from the Bedrock region list, the `anthropic.` model id form, and no wildcard."

options.text: Every action must be one of the three invoke actions allowed
options.says: Ruled out because that rule concerns actions: "Every action is one of the three invoke actions".

options.text: The statements must be allow statements and nothing else at all
options.says: Ruled out because that rule concerns the effect: "only `Allow` statements, and no `NotAction` or `NotResource`".

origin.section: The practice: platform access as configuration, graded by tests

questions.stem: A reviewer sees the ready-made aiplatform user bundle attached to the calling service account. What does the practice require instead?

options.text: A custom role whose only permission is predict
options.says: The rule is "The Vertex role is a custom role (its `id` starts with `projects/` or `organizations/`, not `roles/`) whose only permission is `aiplatform.endpoints.predict`."

options.text: The same bundle plus a deny for the deploy permission
options.says: Ruled out because the rule asks for a role "whose only permission is `aiplatform.endpoints.predict`", and adding a deny leaves the bundle's extra permissions in place.

options.text: A basic Editor grant scoped to one endpoint of the project
options.says: Ruled out because the rule requires a custom role "whose only permission is `aiplatform.endpoints.predict`".

options.text: An organization-level predefined bundle with fewer permissions
options.says: Ruled out because the id "starts with `projects/` or `organizations/`, not `roles/`", and a predefined id starts with `roles/`.

origin.section: The practice: platform access as configuration, graded by tests

questions.stem: A quota file asks for 6,000,000 input tokens per minute with anthropic_approval false. What does the review do?

options.text: It fails the request, since 5,000,000 is the unapproved ceiling
options.says: The rule is "Without Anthropic's approval a quota request is at most 5,000,000 input tokens and 500,000 output tokens per minute."

options.text: It passes the request, since the default is 2,000,000 already
options.says: Ruled out because "Default quota is 2 million input tokens per minute (TPM)." is the starting quota, and a request may go higher up to the ceiling.

options.text: It passes the request, since the output figure is under 500,000
options.says: Ruled out because the ceiling covers both figures: "You can request up to 5 million input TPM and 500,000 output TPM".

options.text: It passes the request once the region has been named in it
options.says: Ruled out because only approval lifts the ceiling: "without additional Anthropic approval".

origin.section: The practice: platform access as configuration, graded by tests

questions.stem: A project with residency us asks for endpoint us-central1 and model claude-opus-5-5. What does the review say?

options.text: It passes, since the global value always satisfies any residency
options.says: Ruled out because the global value is "Dynamic routing for maximum availability", which says nothing of residency.

options.text: It passes, since the region begins with the us prefix
options.says: Ruled out because the prefix rule, "`us` needs `us` or a `us-` region", is met but is not the only rule.

options.text: It fails, since a named location serves one older name only
options.says: The rule is "A specific region serves `claude-sonnet-4-6` only", and the model asked for is newer.

options.text: It fails, since the region is spelled in the wrong form
options.says: Ruled out because the spelling is fine: "`us` needs `us` or a `us-` region".
